companySectionInfo.sectionDescription: The 44th auxiliary companies provide additional ways to play Holdfast with the 44th regiment. Whether you are interested in Competitive Naval Battles, Competitive Melee Group fights and training, or a field Medic. The auxiliary companies have got your back!

companies.name: The 44th Royal Navy / 44th Rum Rats
companies.description: Welcome to the 44th Royal Navy! Fight with us on the high seas, as a sailor, midshipman, marine, carpenter and a captain on a variety of ships and vessels, with huge cannon fights and epic boarding actions. The 44th Royal Navy has multiple naval events every week with a progression system and medals to earn. We are also involved in the Navy Sports League in which we compete under the Rum Rats team with other players in the Holdfast community.

companies.name: The 44th Royal Guard
companies.description: The 44th Royal Guard was founded on members who derived from the regiment, who enjoyed the success of winning in close combat style fighting. Their expert melee skills, have held fast in unprecedented group fights and holdfast events. Their commitment to melee excellence is why the 44th Royal guard is on Top! The 44th Royal Guard attends many group fights and holdfast events, showcasing their exceptional melee skills and dedication to excellence.

companies.name: The 44th Royal Medical Corps
companies.description: The surgeon class is the dedicated medic role in Holdfast which plays a vital role in our linebattle events - a line without a medic has no way of healing injured men and will be broken much quicker. The role of the surgeon in linebattle events is more passive than line infantry but is still capable of offensive action! The Medic Corps has 3 Ranks to work your way up in starting off with Nurse. (The backbone of the corps) Doctor. (The beating heart of the medics) Professor. The Officer role in charge of administration and keeping the other ranks in line.
